form:FormGroup.label: Change
form:FormGroup.helpText: The change to apply to every document that matches the current filter. The other fields shown depend on the change chosen. 'Remove all permissions for all users [DANGEROUS]' cannot be undone.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Applies to all filtered documents. Other fields depend on this choice.

form:FormGroup.label: Document Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The document type whose create permission is added or removed for the chosen user or group. Only shown for 'Add permission to create' and 'Remove permission to create'.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Document type to allow or stop the user or group creating in the filtered folders.

form:FormGroup.label: For User Or Group
form:FormGroup.helpText: The user or group the permission change applies to.

form:FormGroup.label: From Document
form:FormGroup.helpText: The document whose permissions are copied. 'Add all permissions' adds its permissions to the filtered documents; 'Set all permissions' makes them exactly the same as this document's.

form:FormGroup.label: Permission
form:FormGroup.helpText: The permission to give the chosen user or group on each filtered document. Each level includes all lower ones; from lowest to highest: Use, View, Edit, Delete, Owner. Choose '[ none ]' to remove their permission.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Use, View, Edit, Delete or Owner. '[ none ]' removes the permission.
